About this Role

We are looking for someone who loves making things run smoothly and bringing out the best in people! You find it exciting to turn operational chaos into seamless workflows and solve everyday team problems.

If you understand that strong operations and great employee experiences are what power a fast-growing business, we’d love to talk to you!

lists.content:
• Onboarding & Offboarding: Assist with employee documentation, access requests, coordination, and exit formalities to ensure a smooth experience for every team member.
  • Database & Tracker Upkeep: Maintain accurate, up-to-date HR records, attendance/leave logs, and internal operation trackers in Google Sheets/Excel.
  • Employee Queries: Help address everyday employee queries regarding company policies, leave balances, and documentation.
  • Engagement & Events: Assist in planning and executing team celebrations, in-person engagement activities, and cultural events.
  • Cross-Functional Follow-Ups: Proactively follow up with internal teams and stakeholders to ensure pending operational tasks are completed on time.
  • Process Automation: Spot repetitive, manual tasks in your workflow and explore ways to automate them using AI tools and simple integrations.
  • SOP Maintenance: Draft and update process guides and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to keep internal documentation fresh.

• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with a strong eye for accuracy in records and data
  • Good working knowledge of Excel.
  • Strong follow-up skills and ownership of tasks from start to finish
  • You close loops, meet timelines, and keep things running smoothly without needing reminders.
  • Clear and prompt communication skills

• You’ve used AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to get work done
  • Some exposure to automation tools or an HRMS (Keka or similar)
  • Internship experience in HR domain

• Lean Team, High Impact: Work directly with a small team where your work directly shapes employee experience daily.

  • AI-Native Culture: Get hands-on experience using AI tools and simple automations to modernize everyday HR workflows.
  • Fast-Paced Ecosystem: Experience the energy of a fast-growing startup building payments for the next generation.

About the Role
 
We are looking for a Security Enthusiast who thinks like a hacker but works for the good guys. You shouldn't just find bugs; you should be obsessed with understanding why they exist and how to fix them for good.
 
As an Application Security Engineer Intern, you will be the first line of defense for the Fam. You will break things before the bad guys do, automate security checks, and work side-by-side with our engineering team to build a fortress around our users' hard-earned money.
 
If you get a rush from finding an RCE, live on r/netsec, or spend your weekends capturing flags or bounties, this role is for you.
 
Note: This is an onsite internship at Fam HQ, Bangalore.

About the Role
 
We are looking for a Security Enthusiast who thinks like a hacker but works for the good guys. You shouldn't just find bugs; you should be obsessed with understanding why they exist and how to fix them for good.
 
As an Application Security Engineer Intern, you will be the first line of defense for the Fam. You will break things before the bad guys do, automate security checks, and work side-by-side with our engineering team to build a fortress around our users' hard-earned money.
 
If you get a rush from finding an RCE, live on r/netsec, or spend your weekends capturing flags or bounties, this role is for you.
 
Note: This is an onsite internship at Fam HQ, Bangalore.
 
Curious to know about FamPay's tech stack? Click here to know what makes and keeps Fam running!

lists.content:
• Break the App: Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration testing (VAPT) on our Web Applications, Android/iOS Apps, and APIs.
  • Automate Defense: Help integrate security tools (SAST/DAST) into our CI/CD pipelines. We believe security should move as fast as our code.
  • Code Review: Review source code for security flaws (like SQLi, XSS, IDOR) and help developers write secure code from day one.
  • Bug Triage: Analyze incoming bug reports from our Bug Bounty programs, validate them, and prioritize fixes.
  • Threat Modeling: Work with product and engineering teams during the design phase to identify potential security risks before a single line of code is written.
  • Learn & Evolve: Stay updated with the latest CVEs, zero-days, and security trends.

• The Hacker Mindset: You have a deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10 (Web & Mobile) and know how to exploit and patch them.
  • Tool Wizardry: Hands-on experience with tools like Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Postman, or similar open-source security tools.
  • Coding Chops: You can read code (Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript) and write scripts to automate attacks or defenses.
  • Curiosity: You are a student of the game. You actively participate in CTFs, Bug Bounties, or have a rank on platforms like HackTheBox/TryHackMe.
  • Communication: You can explain a complex vulnerability to a developer without sounding like a robot.

• Experience with Cloud Security (AWS/GCP).
  • A Hall of Fame mention in any major tech company's Bug Bounty program.
  • Open source security contributions.

• Impact: You’ll be protecting the financial data of millions of teenagers. The bugs you find and fix will have a direct, real-world impact.
  • Mentorship: Work directly with founding members and senior engineers who have built systems at scale.
  • Perks: Competitive stipend, Certificate and Letter of Recommendation, Friendly leave policy, and cool Fam merchandise!
    •  
    Ready to be part of the Fam? Apply Now and complete this challenge - https://ctf.fampay.co/

About this Role:
We are looking for a meticulous and driven member to join our finance team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will be a Semi-Qualified Chartered Accountant with a strong background in professional services (CA firms) and a deep understanding of full-cycle accounting.
In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) reconciliations, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations.

lists.content:
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records, ensuring all transactions comply with accounting standards
  • Manage end-to-end Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes, including aging analysis and reconciliations
  • Perform monthly bank, vendor, and inter-company reconciliations to ensure data accuracy and integrity
  • Use ZOHO Books for day-to-day accounting, reporting, and process automation
  • Support GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance filings, and assist in year-end audit preparation with organized documentation
  • Prepare periodic financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet) and MIS reports for management review

• Semi-Qualified CA (Inter CA cleared)
  • 3–5 years of practical experience in bookkeeping and accounting
  • Prior exposure to CA firms or managing multiple client accounts/audit assignments is a strong plus
  • Hands-on experience with ZOHO Books or the ZOHO Finance Suite
  • Advanced Excel proficiency (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, financial modeling)
  • Strong understanding of AR/AP cycles, reconciliations, and statutory compliances (GST/TDS)

• Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy
  • Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage tight month-end timelines
  • Effective communication skills to coordinate with vendors and internal/external stakeholders

• Work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Gain exposure to diverse financial portfolios and real business impact.
  • Competitive compensation and accelerated career growth for ambitious finance talent.
